chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: The Eighty-One and Ninety-One theatres on Decatur Street
summary: He played Atlanta theatres including midnight shows for white audiences; cousin Valerie Walton played piano there.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: At the garden, was this a place where out-of-town bands came also?
I don't think they had any out-of-town bands. coming into Atlanta.
No traveling vaudeville shows or anything like that?
Well, they did have a vaudeville show but they were playing at two of the theatres. He played there also, Eighty-One and Ninety-One.
What were the names of the theatres?
The Eighty-One and the Ninety-One ... on Decatur Street in Atlanta.
And Jay C. used to come up and play at the Eighty-One and Ninety-One?
He played there. I had a first cousin, a girl, used to play there. She played piano.
Saturday night, ... They had these midnight shows for white people.
They had me to sit in and play.
